artworks.title: Herod and Herodias
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a table. The drawing features several figures situated in a room around a rectangular table, which is covered with a cloth. They appear to be engaged in conversation or activity, with some figures concentrating on objects on the table, such as a loaf of bread and a cup. In the background, there is a small framed image on the wall and an arched window which shows a pastoral scene with additional figures. The style of the drawing is detailed, featuring intricate linework and shading to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Crucified Man
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular, nude male figure in a dynamic pose. He has his right leg folded at the knee, balancing on his toes, and his left leg extended back. His right arm is bent at the elbow and his left arm is fully extended forward. His head is turned to the left, with defined facial features and short, curly hair. The figure is wearing draped fabric around his lower back. The background includes grass-like vegetation at the bottom and a cityscape visible in the distance on the right side.

artworks.title: Satyr's Family
artworks.description: This image shows mythological figures in a natural setting. There is a satyr beside a female figure, possibly a nymph, who is holding a child with goat-like legs. The satyr is playing a pan flute. They are seated against a tree surrounded by tall grasses and cattails, suggesting a marshy or riverbank location. At the bottom, another childlike figure resembling a faun is leaning over a basin or bowl, possibly interacting with the water. The intricate use of line work with detailed cross-hatching defines the figures and the natural background. The drawing portrays a peaceful, pastoral scene typical of mythological depictions from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Solomon Worshipping False Gods
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.3 × 15.6 cm (7 3/16 × 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures inside a room with a vaulted, wooden ceiling. The first figure, a standing woman, is depicted in profile and is elegantly dressed in a long, flowing gown with voluminous sleeves and a bodice. Her hair is styled elaborately on top of her head. Opposite her, a second figure, dressed in a cloak and elaborate head covering, is kneeling on the ground with hands clasped in front of her chest. Both figures appear to be concentrating on a distant point, with the standing woman pointing toward the horizon outside, visible through arched windows. In the background, beyond the room's arched windows, a picturesque landscape unfolds, consisting of a castle nestled amongst trees and rolling hills. The image is detailed with light and shading, adding depth and texture to the figures and the architectural details that frame them. On the right side, there is a small sculpted figure holding a snake wrapped around what appears to be a staff, standing on a pedestal.

artworks.title: Studies of the Head of Saskia and Others
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.1 x 12.7 cm (5 15/16 x 5 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with several bust-length portraits. The central portrait features a person with curly hair and detailed facial features. Surrounding this figure are five other individuals in different poses: an elderly person, a veiled figure, and three other figures. The portraits showcase distinct facial expressions and features like wavy hair and softly rendered eyes. The background is plain, drawing attention to the sketched figures. The artist's signature is visible beneath the central portraits, dating the work to 1635.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to the Apostles
artworks.description: The image shows detailed sketches of multiple figures in various poses. The central figure stands slightly off-center with a straight posture and an aura-like effect around the head. The facial features are detailed, with long hair and distinct facial structure. The figures around the central one are sitting, kneeling, or seated on a chair to the left. They have their heads bowed, hands clasped, or raised. The clothing appears to be draped robes, creating a historical or cultural context. The sketch uses simple line-drawing style with strokes indicating shadows and form, focusing solely on the figures and their interactions.

artworks.title: Small Gray Landscape: a House and Trees beside a Pool
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon holds dense tree lines, continuing into the distance. The artwork uses cross-hatching and linear strokes for texture. The monochromatic color palette uses dark ink shades on a light background. A figure stands near a small building, adding scale to the scene. The sky above has elongated streaks that could represent clouds or light filtering through the atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Second Oriental Head
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn after Jan Lievens
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in profile, facing to the left. The person is sitting and their face is visible from the side, revealing strong, etched lines suggesting an elderly visage with pronounced facial features such as a prominent nose and a visible eye. Their hair is covered by a cap with a fur-like texture, layered under a striped turban. The person wears a garment with a thick, dark collar that also seems to be lined with fur or a similarly textured material. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is plain with slight sketch marks adding texture, and there is a signature written in a handwritten style at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Bearded Man, Looking Down, Three Quarters Right
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of an older man with a detailed face and hair. He appears to be in a slight forward lean, looking downwards. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a textured beard and mustache. His hair is full and bushy, and slightly unkempt. The man's body fades into etched strokes forming a shadow around him. The background is plain, focusing on the man's intricate facial features. The image is a black and white etching with sharp detail on the man and a soft surrounding area.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures I (Title Page)
artworks.description: This image features a decorative title page surrounded by figures ornamented with foliage. The central focus is an intricately designed title plaque with elegant script detailing the work. Surrounding this text are depictions of cherubic figures enveloped in foliage, leaves, and flowers, displaying classical nudity and carrying branches adorned with leaves. The composition blends text and illustrative decoration, showcasing ornate historical book or manuscript cover aesthetics. The style resembles detailed engraving or etching techniques.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures II
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four cherubic figures under a series of semicircular arches. Each figure is depicted with botanical elements, such as large leaves, fruits, or branch-like elements. The arched backdrop adds structure to the piece. The black and white etching style with fine lines and shading creates an intricate and detailed texture throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures III
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting playful scenes. The image is divided into three arch-shaped sections. Each section contains a pair of putti, or cherubic figures, engaged in various activities. In the left section is a floral archway. In the central section, two putti are wrestling beneath hanging objects. In the right section, another pair of putti is engaging in a playful tussle beneath more hanging items. The drawing conveys movement and interaction, with intricate details adding to the whimsical and playful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures IV
artworks.description: This image depicts two allegorical figures within architectural arches. Two nude figures are shown in each arch, accompanied by symbolic objects. The figure on the left holds a bouquet of flowers and a staff, with a smaller child-like figure nearby. The figure on the right also holds a bouquet of flowers and an elongated object, accompanying a smaller figure. Both figures have flowing hair and dynamic poses, set in a richly cross-hatched background with added depth through light and shadow. The arches are framed by columns, giving a classical architectural style. The drawing is detailed and showcases a high level of craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures V
artworks.description: The image shows a series of detailed shapes forming three arched panels. Within each arch are human figures with sinuous lines representing limbs, hair, and foliage, creating an abstract representation of human forms intertwined with nature. The figures appear to be women standing amid swirling lines reminiscent of vines and leaves, while smaller child-like figures accompany them. The curvature of the arches and the swirling lines mimic elements found in natural settings, such as tree branches and leaves, giving the artwork an organic yet abstract quality.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures VI
artworks.description: The composition is divided into four arched sections, each containing a distinct figure. The first arch on the left contains a figure holding an animal hide over its head, with the hide draping down behind. The second figure appears to have clear musculature, holding an item overhead resembling a bushy tail or plume. Within the third arch, a figure stands with an exaggerated musculature, holding a club or staff. In the final arch, a skeletal figure is shown in a dynamic posture, also holding a staff. The arches are decorated with columns and the figures share a continuous, textured background.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures VII
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four skeletal figures in arched niches. The drawing presents a series of skeletal and partly muscular human figures set within four connected archways. Each niche features a figure holding different objects: in the first niche, a skeletal figure wields a scythe; the second niche displays a figure with a bow and arrow, partially muscular; the third niche shows a skeleton aiming a bow, while the fourth one depicts another partly muscular figure with a bow and quiver. The arches are adorned with columns, and the background is finely hatched to provide depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures VIII
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in unique postures and attributes within framed segments. Each figure has elongated limbs and exaggerated features, interacting with various objects like jars and long-handled tools. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings, with intricate linework and shading creating depth and texture. The figures have distinctive flowing hair or headdresses, contributing to the dramatic flair. The setting suggests a fictional or allegorical scene, emphasized by the stylized posture and abstract environment.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures IX
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in various dynamic poses. The image is divided into four arch-shaped sections, with each section showing a muscular figure wearing feathered headdresses and skirts. The figures are depicted in mid-action, holding objects like a club, shield, or spear. The drawing style shows influences of renaissance or mannerist art, using hatching and cross-hatching for depth and texture. The composition is theatrical and vivid, conveying a sense of movement and vitality through the energetic poses of the figures.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures X
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting four muscular figures in dynamic poses beneath archways. Each figure is holding a different object. The figures are situated under separate archways of similar designs adorned with detailed foliage or feather-like shapes. The use of hatching and cross-hatching techniques adds texture and depth to the piece, creating a sense of movement and energy. The style of the drawing resembles the intricate line work of Renaissance or early Baroque engravings, emphasizing muscular anatomy and dramatic compositions.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures XI
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in different poses within arches. These figures are depicted in a classical style, each one occupying its own frame or arch. The figures are nude and engaged in various activities, exhibiting muscular physiques with exaggerated postures. The background features a series of arches, providing a grand architectural setting. The figures show intricate detailing of the musculature and shading for depth. They wear ornate feathered headdresses and hold objects like shields and staffs, adding to the dramatic atmosphere of the artwork.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures XII
artworks.description: This is an image of a series of scenes featuring figures beneath arches. The scene is divided into four sections, each with an arch overhead. The figures in each section are depicted in dynamic poses, appearing to be carrying other figures or objects, creating a sense of movement and strength. The figures are muscular and detailed linework emphasizes their athletic forms. There are suggestions of objects, possibly weapons, and dramatic postures and interactions. The background hints at architectural settings, with columns and arches providing depth. The use of shading enhances the three-dimensionality of the figures and settings.

artworks.title: Les divers pourtraicts et figures XIII
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four mythological and anthropomorphic creatures depicted within an arched architectural framework. Each figure has human-like forms with fantastical and mythical attributes such as exaggerated features, animalistic elements, and muscular bodies. Dramatic shadowing and intricate lines create depth and texture. Small creatures are scattered around the figures' feet. The drawing is in a detailed, monochrome style reminiscent of classical engravings.

artworks.title: Paris with the Apple
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century (formerly attributed to Abraham de Bruyn)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11 × 7.2 cm (4 5/16 × 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated in a relaxed pose on a block or stone. He has curly hair, distinct facial features, and a focused expression as he looks at an object in his right hand. His left hand rests on a staff. He is dressed in draped clothing with a piece of cloth around his waist and a cloak over his left shoulder. The background includes trees, buildings, and a bridge, set in a natural landscape with hilly terrain. The scene is framed in a circular medallion with decorative scrollwork and motifs.

artworks.title: Juno
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century (formerly attributed to Abraham de Bruyn)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.9 × 8 cm (4 5/16 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical figure standing in a pastoral landscape. The figure is holding a staff or sceptre. To the left, there is a peacock and another bird. In the background, there are hills and buildings resembling a castle. The image is enclosed in a circular frame embellished with decorative elements.
